caption:
Most owners check their business when something feels off.

By then the leak has been running for weeks.

Run this instead. Five days, five checks, one system each:

Monday: cost per lead
Tuesday: response speed
Wednesday: stuck pipeline leads
Thursday: review requests sent
Friday: old leads re-contacted

Twenty minutes a day catches what a monthly report misses.

DM SCALE

#ServiceBusinessGrowth #LeadFollowUp #CRMForContractors #HomeServiceMarketing #SmallBusinessOwner
rationale: Carousels still lead 2026 B2B saves and depth, and this weekday-mapped operating calendar is a genuinely unclaimed framework distinct from every prior stage, ladder, matrix, decay-curve, lead-debt, triage, and audit model already shipped.
